turns.prompt: What are the main tutor pain points in the blueprint, by scenario?

args.takeaway: Most tutor friction sits where a rule holds a tutor in place and only a supervisor can release it.

replies.text:
**Most tutor friction sits where a rule holds a tutor in place and only a supervisor can release it.**

Here is the scenario-by-scenario breakdown:

Phase: Onboarding
• *Scenario: Session Sign Up*
    ◦ In Session Sign Up › No conflicts — Back Stage Touchpoints × [Review scheduling](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000130208), scheduling stays locked until the last onboarding module is done, so a delayed tutor misses shift selection.

Phase: Pre-session
• *Scenario: Call-off Request*
    ◦ In Call-off Request › Under 12 hours — Regular Tutor × [Files late call-off](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=b0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000180303), a late call-off strips the tutor from the roster at once while the excuse waits on a supervisor.

Phase: In-session
• *Scenario: Student Just Joined*
    ◦ In Student Just Joined › Few or none by 10 min — Lead Tutor × [Wait 10 minutes](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=b2000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000031), tutors cannot end or repurpose a session with no students and wait idle for a supervisor.

Phase: In-session
• *Scenario: Help Request*
    ◦ In Help Request › Routed out — Regular Tutor × [Resolve issue](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=b3000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000033), problems are routed by hand to Slack channels, with no ticketing tool behind them.

Phase: Post-session
• *Scenario: Reporting Hours*
    ◦ In Reporting Hours › Deadline missed — Regular Tutor × [Miss reporting deadline](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=b0000000-0000-4000-8000-0000001e1103), hours logged in PLUS do not reach Workday, so a missed deadline delays the paycheck.

I searched the blueprint just now, so these pain points are current.
